title: Swara Baby Products IPO
summary: Swara Baby Products IPO is a ₹800 crore book-built issue priced at ₹105–₹111 per share, to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO opens on December 2, 2026 and closes on December 4, 2026, with allotment expected on December 7 and listing on December 9, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹14,985 for 135 shares.

b.p: Swara Baby Products IPO is priced at ₹105-111 per share with a total issue size of 800 crore. The IPO has a lot size of 135 shares and will be listed on BSE and NSE.

kv: JM Financial Ltd., Avendus Capital Pvt.Ltd.

Swara Baby Products financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Established in November 2016, Swara Baby Products Limited is a niche contract manufacturer that produces disposable consumer hygiene products with an extensive range of products for baby care, adult incontinence, and feminine hygiene segments. It manufactures baby pant and tape diapers, adult diapers, sanitary napkins, panty liners, and other hygiene products for branded companies and, at the same time, markets its consumer brand products under the brand names 'Cuddles' (baby diapers) and 'Shields' (adult diapers). · · Based on the TKC report, Swara Baby Products ranked as the biggest contract manufacturer in the Indian hygiene manufacturing industry in Fiscal 2025 in terms of market share by value, having 37% market share in baby diaper contract manufacturing and 36% in adult diaper contract manufacturing. The company uses its large-scale manufacturing capability along with centralized research and development, quality assurance, and supply chain to offer customized hygiene solutions. It has added feminine hygiene to its product line after acquiring KAEHPL in December 2025. · · The number of employees of Swara Baby Products Limited as of March 31, 2026 was 775 persons.
Alok Birla, Sangita Birla, Udit Alok Birla, Brainbees Solutions Limited, Anadya Bon Merchari LLP are the company's promoters of Swara Baby Products.

sections.h: Swara Baby Products IPO - Strengths and Risks

b.p: Swara Baby Products IPO strengths and risks highlight key business factors, financial position, and market sentiment that may impact investor interest.

Largest Contract Manufacturer of Hygiene Products: The company is India's largest contract manufacturer by revenue in Fiscal 2025 of baby diapers, adult incontinence products and sanitary napkins with a market share of 38% in baby diapers and 36% in adult diapers in Fiscal 2026.

Single-stop Hygiene Products Manufacturing: The company manufactures variety of products within baby diapers, adult incontinence and feminine hygiene segments with varying size, raw material and technology making it possible for the customers to build various brands at different price points.

Established Customer Relationships: With 'land and expand' approach the company has built relationships from single product to multi-product basis and has shown revenue growth of top ten customers at CAGR of 20.65% in fiscal 2024 to 2026.

Concentration of Manufacturing Operations: The company manufactures goods through four plants, and all are situated in the state of Madhya Pradesh, and hence, is prone to regional risks such as natural calamities, infrastructure issues and regulatory changes which may impact its operations.

Risk Due To Customer Concentration: Revenue contribution from top 10 clients formed 80.31% of revenue in Fiscal 2026, 84.47% in Fiscal 2025 and 85.62% in Fiscal 2024, where there is one corporate promoter as the top customer, and thus, is dependent on them and any deterioration in the relationship would impact the firm.

Risk of Capital Expenditure and Project Implementation: The company intends to spend a substantial part of its Net Proceeds of ₹5,548.46 million on capital expenditure for a new project based on unaudited management estimates, and delivery schedule of some equipment has not been determined yet.
